description: Brass travel clock with attached circular folding stand, fitted in a caramel brown leather pouch-like case with horizontal strap. Folded up in the case are hand written operating instructions along with the repair charges of $37.53; on reverse side of paper is the letterhead for Chester Johnson Antique Clock Repairs and sales, Santa Fe, NM.
